text: Dentist at 10. Groceries after. Picked up the dry cleaning.
Worked from home. Two meetings, wrote the quarterly report, went for a run at 6.
Called the plumber about the radiator. He's coming on Thursday between 8 and 12.
Took the 7:42 train. Read the news. Lunch was a sandwich from the place by the station.
Meeting with Ellis about the budget. We agreed to revisit it next quarter.
Weather: cloudy, 14 degrees. Walked to work. Nothing much else.
Laundry, vacuuming, paid the electricity bill.
Booked the car in for a service on the 14th. Renewed the parking permit.
Had lunch with Moritz. He's switching teams in June. We talked about the new office layout.
Ordinary day. Work, dinner, TV, bed.
Updated the spreadsheet for the inventory. 342 items counted.
Went to the post office. Queue was 15 minutes. Sent the parcel to Aunt Ruth.
Read two chapters of the history book. Notes on the Ottoman trade routes.
Not much to say today. Fine, I suppose.
Training session on the new CRM system from 2 to 4pm. Learned how to export reports.
Doctor's appointment for the annual check-up. Blood pressure normal. Next check in a year.
Grocery list for the week: rice, lentils, spinach, eggs, coffee.
Drove Sunil to the airport at 5am. Back home by 7. Went to work.
Watched a documentary about deep-sea fish. Then bed.
Neither good nor bad today. Just a day.
Changed the bedsheets, cleaned the bathroom, sorted the recycling.
Picked up the kids from school, helped with homework, made pasta.
Conference call with the Singapore office about the Q3 numbers.
Bought new running shoes. Size 42. Same brand as before.
Met with Ms. Varga for the parent-teacher conference. Grades are steady. Need to practise spelling.
Spent the morning filing receipts. Afternoon was emails.
Renewed passport online. Should arrive in three weeks.
Walked 8,000 steps. Ate a salad for lunch. Slept at 11.
Team stand-up at 9:30. Pairing with Rohan on the API migration in the afternoon.
Fed the neighbour's cat while they're away. Watered their plants.
Things are okay. Nothing new.
Library: returned three books, borrowed two. One on gardening, one on Roman history.
Car's MOT passed. Needs new wipers. Ordered online.
Moved the desk to the other side of the room for better light.
Cooked a big batch of chilli for the week. Froze four portions.
Interviewed two candidates for the analyst role. Will discuss with Hannah tomorrow.
Today I mostly sat at my desk and worked through tickets. Closed nine.
Took the bus to the market on Saturday. Bought apples and a new kettle.
Not happy, not sad. Just getting on with things.
Assembled the new chair. Took forty minutes.
Swapped shifts with Olivia so I can do the Tuesday early. Confirmed with the rota manager.
Rained most of the day. Stayed in and tidied the spare room.
Practised piano for 30 minutes. Scales and the second movement.
Picked up Grandma's prescription. Dropped it at her flat. She was napping.
Wrote the minutes for the residents' association meeting. Next meeting is the 3rd of March.
Read the instruction manual for the new oven. It has eleven settings.
Spent the evening backing up photos to the external drive.
Regular Monday. Emails, two calls, lunch at desk.
Hung the new curtains in the living room. Swept the balcony.
Met Ji-ah at the bank to sign the joint account forms. Took an hour.
Day was fine. Uneventful.
Replaced the bike chain. Oiled the gears. Tested it around the block.
Attended the webinar on pension options. Took notes on the three schemes.
Jogged around the park. 5k in 31 minutes. Same route as usual.
Sorted out the bookshelf by colour. Took about an hour.
Visited the new Ikea with Kostas. Bought a lamp and some storage boxes.
Mum phoned. Talked about the weather and her neighbour's new fence.
Nothing special. Ate, worked, slept.
Printed and signed the tenancy renewal. Scanned it back to the agent.
Taught two lessons on fractions. Marked homework. Staff meeting at 4.
Went to see the new exhibition at the Tate with Clara. Lots of sculpture. Had coffee afterwards.
Spent the day cataloguing the archive boxes. Boxes 14 to 22 done.
Mixed day, nothing stood out.
Got a haircut. Same style. Paid £18.
Planned the route for next week's site visits: Leeds, Bradford, York.
Fixed the squeaky door hinge with some oil.
Had a check-in with Jordan. Updated the project timeline. Deadline moved to the 20th.
Walked the dog twice, cooked rice and beans, read before bed.
Took inventory of the pantry. Need flour, oil and tinned tomatoes.
Bank holiday. Stayed home. Did some reading and a bit of gardening.
